slides.title: It is not working!
slides.text: Every device stops working sometimes. Do not panic. Good fixers have a plan.
slides.alt: The Fix-It Desk opens its first ticket: a broken gadget, its story, and the fix options with their minutes.

slides.title: Quick checks first
slides.text: Try the quick, easy checks first: is it on, is it plugged in, is it muted? Restarting takes longer, so it comes later.
slides.alt: A second ticket waits at the desk: the quick, cheap checks are the ones a good fixer tries first.

slides.title: No sound
slides.text: Troubleshooting is a checklist, not a guess. Go down the list in order.
slides.alt: The No Sound ticket: the headphones fix is under way, with plugged in and volume checked on the list.

slides.title: Small clues
slides.text: Your passphrase fails, but you know it? Check caps lock. An app is frozen? Close the app and open it again.
slides.alt: A fourth ticket with a small clue in its story: reading the clue closely points straight at the fix.

words.means: find out why something is not working and fix it
one thing you test, like the volume
turn it off and on again
plug it in or join the network again

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Inside the Machine at Fix-It Desk and solve all 7 tickets. Before you tap, ask: which check is quick and most likely?
slides.alt: The Fix-It Desk opens its first ticket: a broken gadget, its story, and the fix options with their minutes.
